title: Theory that the object was built before the ice age

tellings.quote: Long time ago, perhaps before the ice

plain: A strange round shape on the floor of the Baltic Sea may have been built "long time ago, perhaps before the ice," meaning before the last ice age, according to the treasure hunter Dennis Asberg, whose team found it. Asberg tells Michels this as his own idea, and if true it would mean someone made it long before any known civilisation.
